essence: The verse prescribes the application of the rite for the pacification of a particular individual.
The practitioner should place mantra syllables in order on the hands, nostrils, and head.
The practitioner should thus perform the placement on the private parts, thighs, knees, and feet.
After meditating and worshipping with mental offerings, one should perform the placement of arghya.
The offering or invocation is directed to fire, wind, space, and the sacrificer.
